Name: Send Email
Author: Admin
Description: Use the Send Email action to send emails from a specific mailbox to an arbitrary list of recipients. This action can send either plain text or HTML-formatted emails. With appropriate permissions, the action can send emails from a mailbox different than the one specified in the integration configuration. This action doesn't run on Google SecOps entities.

Parameters.Description: An optional email address from which to send emails if permissions allow it. By default, the action sends emails from the default mailbox specified in the integration configuration.
A comma-separated list of email addresses for the email recipients, such as user1@example.com, user2@example.com.
A comma-separated list of email addresses for the email CC field, such as user1@example.com, user2@example.com.
A comma-separated list of email addresses for the email BCC field, such as user1@example.com, user2@example.com.
A comma-separated list of paths for file attachments stored on the server, for example, /{FILE_DIRECTORY}/file.pdf, /{FILE_DIRECTORY}/image.jpg.
The type of the email content. The default value is Text.

A comma-separated list of recipients to use in the Reply-To header. Use the Reply-To header to redirect reply emails to the specific email address instead of the sender address that is stated in the From field.

A location where the attachments are stored. By default, the action attempts to upload attachments from the Cloud Storage bucket. The possible values are GCP Bucket or Local File System. The default value is GCP Bucket.

AIDescription:
### General Description
The **Send Email** action allows users to send plain text or HTML-formatted emails through the Microsoft Graph API using a delegated mailbox. It supports multiple recipients (To, CC, BCC), custom Reply-To headers, and file attachments sourced from either a Google Cloud Storage (GCP) bucket or the local file system. This action is designed for automated notifications, reporting, or communication within a SOAR workflow and does not operate on specific Google SecOps entities.

### Parameters Description
| Parameter | Type | Mandatory | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Send From** | String | Yes | The email address from which to send the email. If set to 'Default Mailbox', it uses the address configured in the integration settings. |
| **Subject** | String | Yes | The subject line of the email. |
| **Send to** | String | Yes | A comma-separated list of primary email recipients. |
| **CC** | String | No | A comma-separated list of email addresses for the CC field. |
| **BCC** | String | No | A comma-separated list of email addresses for the BCC field. |
| **Attachments Paths** | String | No | A comma-separated list of file paths for attachments (e.g., `/dir/file.pdf`). |
| **Mail Content Type** | String | No | Specifies the format of the email body. Options are `Text` (default) or `Html`. |
| **Mail Content** | String | Yes | The actual content/body of the email. |
| **Reply-To Recipients** | String | No | A comma-separated list of email addresses to be used in the Reply-To header. |
| **Attachment Location** | String | Yes | Defines where the attachments are stored. Options are `GCP Bucket` (default) or `Local File System`. |

### Additional Notes
- The action requires appropriate delegated permissions in Microsoft Entra ID to send emails on behalf of the specified mailbox.
- If attachments are provided, the action will fail if any of the specified files cannot be found at the designated location.

### Flow Description
1. **Parameter Extraction & Validation**: The action retrieves all input parameters and validates the `Mail Content Type`. It also verifies that all specified attachment paths exist in the chosen `Attachment Location` (GCP or Local).
2. **Mailbox Verification**: It validates the `Send From` mailbox address against the Microsoft Graph API to ensure it is active and accessible.
3. **Attachment Loading**: If attachments are specified, the action loads the file content into memory, ensuring no single file exceeds the 20MB limit.
4. **Email Creation & Dispatch**: The action constructs a draft email with the provided subject, body, recipients, and attachments. It then sends the draft using the Microsoft Graph API.
5. **Metadata Retrieval**: After sending, the action polls the 'Sent Items' folder to retrieve the final metadata of the sent email (such as the `internetMessageId`) to confirm success and provide detailed output.
